records.deadline_display: Tuition-fee students may apply for the scholarship during the admission process.

source.raw_extract:
Aalto University Excellence Scholarships are awarded as tuition fee waivers, covering the full tuition fee. Tuition-fee students may apply for the scholarship during the admission process.

In order for the scholarship to be valid, you must agree to the terms of the scholarship by the given deadline.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Tuition-fee students may apply for the scholarship during the admission process.
source.notes: The scholarship has no deadline of its own: it is applied for within the degree programme's admission process, which recurs each admission round, hence ANNUAL / precision 'recurring' and a null deadline_date. The page states no calendar date, month or window for the scholarship, and the 'given deadline' it mentions refers to agreeing the scholarship terms after an award, not to applying. No admission-round date was imported from any Aalto admissions page, and no date was invented. The same page notes other recurring internal milestones (study review by end of March, issues resolved by end of April, annual enrolment beginning in May, credits registered by 31 July); these are post-award obligations and were NOT treated as application deadlines.
